skill.name: generate-image
skill.description: Generate or edit general-purpose images through OpenRouter models such as Gemini and FLUX. It supports prompt-based image creation, image editing, model selection, and PNG output.
skill.summary: Create or edit visual assets with OpenRouter image models.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill performs the advertised image generation workflow, but it uses OpenRouter network calls and handles API credentials. Most Markdown external-command alerts are false positives from examples and code formatting, while .env inspection, external image transfer, and output file writes are real risks.

remediation.suggestion: Do not search parent directories automatically. Read only explicit environment variables or a user-selected config file after consent.

remediation.issue: External transfer of prompts and input images
remediation.suggestion: Show a clear privacy notice before sending prompts or image data to OpenRouter.

remediation.issue: API key exposure through command-line arguments
remediation.suggestion: Remove the --api-key option or warn that command-line secrets can appear in shell history and process listings.
Warn before overwriting files and reject unsafe absolute paths or parent directory traversal.

semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md tells the assistant to look for a .env file and check OPENROUTER_API_KEY before running. This can expose project secrets to the agent context.

semantic_findings.title: Parent Directory Secret Search
semantic_findings.description: The script walks from the current directory through all parents to find .env. This can read credentials from a broader scope than the user intended.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The implementation explicitly iterates over current_dir and current_dir.parents, then opens the first .env file and parses OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

content.value_statement: Creating custom visuals often requires switching tools and managing model settings. This skill wraps OpenRouter image models for prompt-based generation and image edits.
actual_capabilities: Generates new images from text prompts using OpenRouter image models.
Edits an existing PNG, JPEG, GIF, or WebP image from a local path.
Supports model selection for Gemini and FLUX image models.
Saves the first returned image as a PNG file.
Reads an OpenRouter API key from an argument or local .env lookup.
Handles multiple OpenRouter image response formats.
limitations: Requires a valid OpenRouter API key and network access.
Sends prompts and edited input images to OpenRouter.
Does not create technical diagrams or schematics.
Does not validate image rights, licensing, or policy compliance.

use_cases.title: Create Presentation Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate backgrounds, hero images, and concept visuals for slides or posters.

use_cases.title: Draft Marketing Assets
use_cases.description: Produce quick visual concepts for campaigns, social posts, and documentation pages.

use_cases.title: Edit Existing Images
use_cases.description: Modify colors, backgrounds, or visible elements in an existing image.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Visual
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a clean product illustration of [subject] on a plain background. Use a modern style and balanced lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Edit One Image Element
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [image] by changing [element] to [new appearance]. Preserve the main subject, composition, and realistic lighting.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Presentation Artwork
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 16:9 presentation image showing [topic]. Use clear focal points, readable spacing, and colors that match [brand palette].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Model Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate three visual directions for [campaign]. Use [model] for quality, save separate outputs, and compare realism, cost, and editability.

output_examples.input: Prompt: A modern office team collaborating around a digital board.
output_examples.output: A PNG image is saved to the selected output path with status messages from the OpenRouter request.

output_examples.input: Prompt: Make the sky purple in an existing landscape photo.
output: The input image is encoded and sent to OpenRouter for editing.
The edited result is saved as a PNG file.

output_examples.input: Prompt: A scientific concept illustration for an immunotherapy presentation.
output_examples.output: A general-purpose illustration is generated for presentation use, not a formal technical diagram.

best_practices: Use detailed prompts that name the subject, style, lighting, and output purpose.
Confirm user consent before sending private images or sensitive prompts to OpenRouter.
Choose output paths carefully to avoid overwriting existing project files.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for flowcharts, circuits, or formal technical schematics.
Do not pass private images unless external processing is acceptable.
Do not place API keys in command history or shared documentation.

faq.question: What does this skill generate?
faq.answer: It generates and edits general-purpose images such as photos, illustrations, visual concepts, and presentation assets.

faq.question: Which models does it support?
faq.answer: The documentation lists Gemini image preview and FLUX image models through OpenRouter.

faq.question: Does it need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The script requires an OpenRouter API key before it can make image requests.

faq.question: Where are generated images saved?
faq.answer: The script saves the first returned image to the selected output path as a PNG file.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It can send a local input image with editing instructions to a supported OpenRouter model.

faq.question: Is it suitable for technical diagrams?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation directs users to a separate scientific schematics skill for technical diagrams.
